package.description: System-tray Git assistant powered by a local LLM served by LM Studio

en-US.description: System-tray Git assistant powered by a local LLM served by LM Studio
en-US.longDescription:
A system-tray assistant for Git that writes commit messages, reviews staged
changes against your own rule tables, and audits repositories - using a local
language model served by LM Studio, or a hosted provider if you prefer.

Requires Git for Windows, which winget installs alongside it.
en-US.name: Git Assistant
